question: Does this code diff contain leaked sensitive PII (names with phone/SSN/address) or secret credentials (API keys, private tokens, passwords)?

positive_indicators: Real unmasked personal names combined with telephone numbers, residential addresses, or government IDs
Live API keys, JWT bearer tokens with signatures, private cryptographic keys, database passwords in plaintext
negative_indicators: Standard programming variable names, class names, function declarations, imports
Explicit mock test files, synthetic non-routable dummy data (e.g. 555-0199, test@example.com)
Configuration schemas, comments without real personal credentials
